value.name: Marcus asks to hear the rate sheet
value.description: Marcus, sounding rougher than before, asks Asha to read him what the sheet actually says.
evidence: his voice came through rougher than she remembered, asking her to read him what the sheet actually said.

value.name: Asha unfolds and reads the rate sheet
value.description: Asha opens the rate sheet and reads the cheapest option and its charges to Marcus in separate, careful lines.
evidence: Asha unfolded the rate sheet the rest of the way against her thigh

"The cheapest one on here is Bridgeview, out past Levittown," she said, and gave Marcus the monthly figure, then the room-and-board line under it, then the medication surcharge, each one set down separately into the quiet on his end.

value.name: Asha notices her father's breathing
value.description: While reading, Asha watches her father's chest rise and fall instead of focusing on the page.
evidence: Her father's hand lay open on the sheet beside her, fingers curled loose, and she found she was watching the small rise of his chest instead of the page while she read.

value.name: Marcus silently processes the cost
value.description: Marcus does not interrupt, swallows, and picks up a pen as he absorbs the numbers.
evidence: Marcus didn't interrupt; she heard him swallow once, and then the soft scrape of something—a pen, maybe—being picked up.

value.name: Rosa urges Asha to state the number
value.description: Asha receives another text from Rosa telling her to give Marcus the number and not apologize for the cost.
evidence: Her phone buzzed once more under the blanket, and Asha tilted it: Now give him the number. Don't apologize for the cost.

value.name: Asha sets the phone aside
value.description: Asha puts the phone face-down beside the rate sheet and lets the silence on the call continue.
evidence: She set the screen face-down on her thigh beside the rate sheet and let the quiet on the line stretch

value.name: Asha asks if they can afford the placement
value.description: Asha asks Marcus whether they can make the Bridgeview placement work, speaking softly so as not to disturb her father.
evidence: "Do you think we can make this work, Marcus?" she asked, and kept her voice low enough not to disturb the man between them.

value.name: Marcus hesitates in silence
value.description: Marcus stops the pen movement on his end and remains silent after Asha's question.
